question: Can fixed assistant-response-derived causal rules be compiled into a <128-byte deterministic native numerical program, cold-restored, and applied to previously unscored parameter combinations without teacher inference at recipient time, while exposing no independent scientific gain?
hypothesis: A finite frozen six-rule idealized resistive-circuit donor can be converted into a domain-neutral arithmetic bytecode; matched exact symbolic access will tie and thus this cannot establish intelligence or causal learning superiority.
predecessor_evidence: spoonman136668-ai/Yggdrasil PR #1347 DWSA06 80.75% vs supervised 99.25%, DWSA09 head-only no-go

spoonman136668-ai/Yggdrasil WSP89/WSP90 and CKAD/NKR factual-knowledge controls already exist; this is a *different* explicit response-to-causal-operator feasibility probe, not new novel-world science
source_class: Author-generated GPT-6 response claims, not pretrained weights; generating donor response itself uses model inference; no teacher-model calls after freezing. These textbook ideal circuit relationships are authored and not independently source-admitted; every score is synthetic DEV only.

donor_claims.scope: two ideal linear resistors in series
two ideal linear resistors in parallel

inputs.name: self-contained ideal-circuit synthetic DEV
inputs.source: Deterministic xorshift32 seeds 71,131,211; no external observations; donor rules explicitly listed above and immutable after prereg

frozen_design.split: For each seed, 128 series and 128 parallel independent parameter sets; exactly 768 DEV cases total. Same ideal physics family, disjoint sampled parameter tuples only; no novel-law claims.
frozen_design.ordering: seed ascending; topology series then parallel; 128 draws in each group; same rows to student, symbolic, and sham controls
frozen_design.rng: xorshift32 with uint32 state, draw u=x/4294967296 after x ^= x<<13;x ^= x>>>17;x ^= x<<5
frozen_design.data_budget: 768 synthetic DEV cases, zero real-world actions
frozen_design.compute_budget: one source-only Node.js >=20 replay and one diagnostic output; no paid API, no teacher model inference after frozen donor
frozen_design.capacity: fixed five-byte instructions: 9 ops x5, 8-byte header, 32-byte SHA-256 =85 bytes
frozen_design.instruction_format: [opcode,destination,left,right,aux]; opcodes generic ADD=1 MUL=2 DIV=3 SELECT_IF_TOPOLOGY_1=4. Public input registers [V,R1,R2,t,m,c,topology] indices 0..6. Intermediate registers 7..15. No domain-specific physics opcode; compile exactly the six frozen formulas.
frozen_design.evaluator: Independent direct symbolic formula implementation (not calling bytecode compiler) is the numerical reference; maximum per-case normalized absolute error max |student - symbolic|/max(1,|symbolic|) over [R_eff,I,P,E,delta_T] across all 768 cases
frozen_design.cold_restore: Compile once; three fresh decode/evaluate cycles; recompile bytes equality; tamper and re-signed invalid program test
frozen_design.negative_controls: (1) change the final temperature op from DIV to ADD with re-signed digest; (2) topology=2 must be rejected; (3) zero resistance, zero mass or nonfinite inputs must be rejected; (4) zero/digest-corrupt payload rejected
frozen_design.test_environment: Node built-in crypto, no third-party packages

controls: Exact symbolic same-donor formulas: strongest lawful exact rule control; expected 0 difference, not matched byte cost, therefore never claim superiority.
Re-signed sham with wrong last operator; must perform worse on temperature output on >=99% of DEV rows.
No-donor zero output is illustrative only, not an independently trained control.

classification_rules.supported: ENGINEERING_DEV_PASS iff 85-byte stable checkpoint, 0 runtime teacher calls, max relative error <=1e-12 for all 768 cases, symbolic tie on all 768, sham temperature materially wrong on >=99%, 3 cold restores, and all invalid/tamper guards PASS. SCIENTIFIC_PASS always false for this test.
classification_rules.mixed: ENG_MIXED iff only one engineering check fails without invalid evaluation custody; scientific gain remains UNVERIFIED.
classification_rules.negative: ENG_NO_GO iff wrong numerical results, checkpoint corruption admitted, unknown-world prediction emitted, or sham not distinguishable. Scientific gain always not demonstrated.
classification_rules.invalid: Changed frozen rules/splits/thresholds, retrospective score fitting, duplicated consumed first-use, source mismatch, teacher inference after donor freeze, or test/evaluator leakage.

prohibited_after_primary_run: extra data/compute/model calls unless separately preregistered
preregistration_note: This prereg-only Git commit MUST precede implementation and any DEV score. This is a source- and implementation-feasibility probe, not independent causal transfer or training.
